finalText:
**Build passes now.** Exit code `0`, no errors.

Two real bugs, both from the bump's changed shapes, not the deprecation noise:

- `[options.js:6](src/core/options.js:6)` read `options.retries`, but the new bundler passes `retryCount`. Fixed to read `retryCount`.
- `[retryPolicy.js:7](src/net/retryPolicy.js:7)` threw when `backoffEnabled` was `undefined`, since the new config loader stopped defaulting it to `false`. Now treats `undefined` the same as `false`.

The remaining `WARN` lines (DEP0142, DEP0198, W1042, etc) are pure noise from the bump, not build-breaking. Left as is unless you want those addressed too.
